business_problem: Pet Circle needed to replace fragmented and conflicting reports with one governed business layer that could scale with more than 10 terabytes of data and support conversational analytics without retraining AI for every definition.
solution_summary: Pet Circle uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Pet Circle needed to replace fragmented and conflicting reports with one governed business layer that could scale with more than 10 terabytes of data and support conversational analytics without retraining AI for every definition. Looker acts as the full business layer and semantic system of record for company metrics, definitions, and self-service analytics, serving as the serving layer. BigQuery stores the growing data lake and business layers that power Pet Circle’s analytics foundation, serving as the storage layer. Dataflow supports the automated metadata foundation that injects definitions into the governed analytics stack, serving as the orchestration layer. Dataform helps automate and structure the metadata-driven modeling foundation on Google Cloud, serving as the orchestration layer.

evidence_quotes: Pet Circle utilised Looker and BigQuery to move from fragmented, conflicting reports to a 'trusted time' architecture.
This system automates the injection of rich metadata—including business definitions, column descriptions, and data ownership—directly into BigQuery and Looker.

data_flow: Operational and commerce data lands in BigQuery, metadata and definitions are injected into the governed modeling layer, Looker and LookML expose one trusted business vocabulary, and conversational analytics agents use that semantic layer to answer natural-language questions accurately.
